entities.name: P. trichocarpa drought methylation
observations: The direct study title and design indicate an association between DNA methylation and drought stress in Populus trichocarpa using single-base-resolution methylomes.

A later whole-genome bisulfite study in Populus nigra found drought-induced global CHH hypermethylation, especially at transposable-element superfamilies near drought-responsive genes; this is convergent but not direct evidence for P. trichocarpa.

source_tools.relevance: Convergent high-resolution poplar drought methylome evidence and species distinction.
